note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the Nebraska 109th Legislature (LegiScan 2185). Nebraska has one house, so every seat is a senate seat and LegiScan's `district` field is read in preference to `role`. The 14 committee sponsor pseudo-people in the people file (blank district) are excluded, the Maryland shape, leaving 50 members: the 49 senators plus one mid-term replacement in District 41. 12 of them map to a candidate: 11 proposed by the resolver and accepted after checking each one's seat against the candidate's district, and one added by hand. The other 38 are deliberate nulls, each with its reason. Most are structural: only half of Nebraska's districts vote in any one year, so most sitting senators cannot appear on the November 2026 ballot at all.
